segments.ja474:1.1: Ahāsi [āhāsi (?)] me ambaphalāni pubbe, aṇūni thūlāni ca brahmacāri;
segments.ja474:1.3: Teheva mantehi na dāni tuyhaṃ, dumapphalā pātubhavanti brahme.
segments.ja474:2.1: Nakkhattayogaṃ paṭimānayāmi, khaṇaṃ muhuttañca mante na passaṃ [khaṇaṃ muhuttaṃ na maṃ tosayanti (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja474:2.3: Nakkhattayogañca khaṇañca laddhā, addhāharissambaphalaṃ [athāharissambaphalaṃ (sī. pī.)] pahūtaṃ.
segments.ja474:3.1: Nakkhattayogaṃ na pure abhāṇi, khaṇaṃ muhuttaṃ na pure asaṃsi;
segments.ja474:3.3: Sayaṃ harī [athāharī (sī. syā. pī.)] ambaphalaṃ pahūtaṃ, vaṇṇena gandhena rasenupetaṃ.
segments.ja474:4.1: Mantābhijappena pure hi [pura’ ssa (sī. pī.), purepi (syā.)] tuyhaṃ, dumapphalā pātubhavanti brahme;
segments.ja474:4.3: Svājja na pāresi jappampi mantaṃ [japampi mante (sī. pī.)], ayaṃ so ko nāma tavajja dhammo.
segments.ja474:5.1: Caṇḍālaputto mama sampadāsi, dhammena mante pakatiñca saṃsi;
segments.ja474:5.3: Mā cassu me pucchito nāmagottaṃ, guyhittho atthaṃ [mā taṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vijaheyya manto [vijaheyyumantā (syā.)].
segments.ja474:6.1: Sohaṃ janindena janamhi puṭṭho, makkhābhibhūto alikaṃ abhāṇiṃ;
segments.ja474:6.3: “Mantā ime brāhmaṇassā”ti micchā, pahīnamanto kapaṇo rudāmi.
segments.ja474:7.1: Eraṇḍā pucimandā vā, atha vā pālibhaddakā;
segments.ja474:7.3: Madhuṃ madhutthiko vinde, so hi tassa dumuttamo.
segments.ja474:8.3: Yamhā dhammaṃ vijāneyya, so hi tassa naruttamo.
segments.ja474:9.1: Imassa daṇḍañca vadhañca datvā, gale gahetvā khalayātha [balayātha (syā.), galayātha (ka.)] jammaṃ;
segments.ja474:9.3: Yo uttamatthaṃ kasirena laddhaṃ, mānātimānena vināsayittha.
segments.ja474:10.1: Yathā samaṃ maññamāno pateyya, sobbhaṃ guhaṃ narakaṃ pūtipādaṃ;
segments.ja474:10.3: Rajjūti vā akkame kaṇhasappaṃ, andho yathā jotimadhiṭṭhaheyya;
segments.ja474:10.5: Evampi maṃ tvaṃ khalitaṃ sapañña [sapaññā (pī.)], pahīnamantassa punappadāhi [puna sampadāhi (syā.), punappasīda (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja474:11.1: Dhammena mantaṃ [mante (sī. syā. pī.)] tava sampadāsiṃ, tuvampi dhammena [tvampi dhammeneva (ka.)] pariggahesi;
segments.ja474:11.3: Pakatimpi te attamano asaṃsiṃ, dhamme ṭhitaṃ taṃ [patiṭṭhaṃ (ka.)] na jaheyya manto.
segments.ja474:12.1: Yo bāla mantaṃ [balamantaṃ (ka.)] kasirena laddhaṃ, yaṃ dullabhaṃ ajja manussaloke;
segments.ja474:12.3: Kiñcāpi laddhā jīvituṃ appapañño [kicchā laddhaṃ jīvikaṃ appapañño (sī. syā.), kacchāpi laddhā jīvikaṃ appañña (pī.)], vināsayī alikaṃ bhāsamāno.
segments.ja474:13.1: Bālassa mūḷhassa akataññuno ca, musā bhaṇantassa asaññatassa;
segments.ja474:13.3: Mante mayaṃ tādisake na dema, kuto mantā gaccha na mayha ruccasīti.
